Use at most one nor_conv_1x1 operator per cell, and place it on an early or middle edge (such as node2<-node0 or node3<-node2) to modestly reduce latency without noticeable accuracy loss. More than one nor_conv_1x1 per cell may reduce accuracy and does not significantly lower latency.

Use skip_connect on a single early edge (preferably node1<-node0 or node3<-node0) to reduce latency while maintaining high accuracy. Avoid adding skip_connect to multiple edges in the same cell, as this can cause a notable drop in accuracy.
Avoid using the none (zeroize) operator on any edge, as it consistently leads to significant accuracy degradation with negligible latency improvement.

Avoid avg_pool_3x3 unless required for architectural diversity. If used, restrict to at most one per cell, and place only on the last edge (node3<-node2), since it offers no accuracy gain and can increase latency.
